system.description: For making Attack Skill Checks with incendiary devices. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you are able to safely handle incendiary devices.

upgrades.description: You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of incendiary devices you handle.
You are able to craft incendiary devices as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have incendiary raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
Add a +5 Splash to your crafted device at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.
